description:
Play Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties now on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/yakuza-kiwami-3-and-dark-ties-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1057-01&utm_id=P1057-01

A legend is reborn and a new legacy begins in this two-in-one, action-adventure experience! Rejoin Kazuma Kiryu as he fights to protect those he loves in the extreme remake of Yakuza 3 that evolves every aspect of the beloved game, from reimagined combat to added scenes and side experiences. In the included side game Dark Ties, experience the brand-new tale of Yoshitaka Mine from Yakuza 3 as the pursuit to find true bonds drives him into a dramatic, action-filled journey of boxing-based combat.
